purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0091 in the spin arena: the covariant coin in the doublet-locked knit: a lone vibe gains the stand-in's mass (rest gap 2 pi/3, top speed 1/2) at the price of the lattice momentum, and the coin makes the fermion sign physical; on the husk-line charge-one sectors (three loves on one bulk line, two plus one, one per parallel line) whether the drift phase binds the natural spin one half that travels, and whether g can be read.
